description: The exact version combination that the M0 acceptance was produced with. M1 must either reuse this combination or record why it differs, so that a numerical difference can be attributed to the code and not to a dependency drift.

packaging_tool.name: extension-ci-tools
packaging_tool.role: development-only; it appends the extension metadata and is not part of the extension's dependency graph or its runtime path

m1_note: M1 may choose a different numerical stack, but it must record the combination it used and compare against this baseline. The DuckDB extension version and the ABI type are tied to the host: changing either requires re-verifying the extension load and the error recovery.
